verdict.rationale: Auth0 ships an official, first-party MCP Server documented as letting users "manage your Auth0 tenant through natural language" from AI tools like Claude Desktop, Cursor, or Windsurf. Through it, users can create apps, deploy Actions, debug logs, and manage users without touching the dashboard. An "Agent Mode" for the Auth0 CLI is also listed in the changelog. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface inside Auth0 itself (it relies on an external AI client), independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language operations work reliably, and detail on Agent Mode.
